about.body: ⁧محرر PDF⁩ is an open, account-free, Arabic-first editor for PDF files. Everything runs locally in your browser: no file is uploaded, and a document's text leaves your device only when you send it to an AI model yourself.
ai.answerNote: The answer is not added to the PDF. Check it against the pages it cites.
ai.billing: Anthropic reports a billing problem on the account of this key (402).
ai.blockedClaude: This build's security policy does not allow connecting to {url}. Use a build of ⁧محرر PDF⁩ that allows it.
ai.blockedLocal: This build's security policy does not allow connecting to {url}. Use Ollama's address, http://localhost:11434, or LM Studio's, http://localhost:1234/v1, or a build of ⁧محرر PDF⁩ that allows this one.
ai.busy: The service is overloaded right now. Try again in a little while.
ai.cancelled: Stopped waiting. The request had already been sent; its answer will not be shown.
ai.claude: Claude (Anthropic), with your own API key
ai.claudeNote: The key and the text you send go to api.anthropic.com and nowhere else. ⁧محرر PDF⁩ has no server of its own and keeps no copy.
ai.copyFailed: The answer could not be copied; select it and copy it instead.
ai.cutOff: The answer reached its length limit and may be incomplete.
ai.denied: This key is not allowed to use this model (403).
ai.intro: Summarize, question or translate the open document with a model you choose. Nothing is sent until you have seen what will go and where, and pressed Send.
ai.invalidUrl: That is not a valid address. It looks like http://localhost:11434.
ai.keyRejected: Anthropic did not accept this API key (401). Check it, or create a new one in the Claude Console.
ai.leftOut: Not sent: pages {pages}. One request carries at most {budget} characters of text.
ai.local: A local model on this computer
ai.localDown: Nothing answered at {url}. Make sure the local server is running (for Ollama: ollama serve) and allows this app's address (Ollama: OLLAMA_ORIGINS; LM Studio: turn on CORS in its server settings).
ai.localNote: The model runs on this computer, so the text stays on it. It must already be installed and running — with Ollama, for example: ollama pull gemma3.
ai.modelMissingClaude: Anthropic does not offer the model “{model}” to this key (404).
ai.modelMissingLocal: The local server does not have the model “{model}”. Install it first (for Ollama: ollama pull {model}) or check its name.
ai.needKey: Enter your Anthropic API key first.
ai.needModel: Enter the name of an installed model first.
ai.noText: These pages have no text ⁧محرر PDF⁩ can read — they may be scanned images — so there is nothing to send.
ai.notLocal: A local model has to run on this computer: use localhost or 127.0.0.1 in the address.
ai.nothingFits: Page {page} alone holds more text than one request can carry ({budget} characters).
ai.offline: Could not reach {host}. Check the internet connection and try again.
ai.openaiNote: An OpenAI-compatible server applies its own context length, and may cut a longer text.
ai.portNote: The web and desktop apps of ⁧محرر PDF⁩ connect only to ports 11434 (Ollama) and 1234 (LM Studio) on this computer; another address is refused.
ai.question: Your question
ai.questionSent: Your question is sent with the text.
ai.rate: Anthropic's rate limit was reached (429). Wait a minute, then send again.
ai.readFailed: The text of the document could not be read.
ai.redactPending: Some text is marked for redaction but not redacted yet, so it is still in the file. Apply or clear the marks in Redact first.
ai.remember: Remember this key on this device
ai.rememberFailed: This browser would not store the key; it is kept only until ⁧محرر PDF⁩ is closed.
ai.rememberNote: A remembered key is stored in this browser, where anyone with access to this device's browser profile can read it.
ai.server: The service had a problem ({status}). Try again later.
ai.showText: Show exactly what will be sent
ai.thinking: The model is thinking before it answers…
ai.tooLarge: The text is too large for one request (413). Choose fewer pages.
app.name: محرر PDF
app.tagline: An open, account-free, Arabic-first PDF editor
combine.failed: The files could not be combined.
combine.intro: Choose two or more PDFs. Their pages become one new file, in the order listed.
combine.needTwo: Add at least one more file.
combine.note: The files you chose are not changed. Form fields keep working; bookmarks come from the first file only.
combine.unreadable: A file could not be read as a PDF.
create.failed: The PDF could not be made from these files.
create.fidelity: ⁧محرر PDF⁩ lays out the content itself, in its own fonts: text and its direction, headings, lists, tables, pictures, headers and footers, and slides’ boxes come across. Complex layouts do not: columns, Word’s text boxes and shapes, charts, SmartArt, animations.
create.intro: Make a PDF from Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, web pages, Markdown, text, CSV and pictures, here on this device. Several files become one PDF, in the order listed.
create.list: Files to make into a PDF
create.missingGlyphs: Characters with no shape in ⁧محرر PDF⁩’s fonts, shown as empty boxes: {count}.
create.ocr: Then read the text in the pictures (Scan & OCR)
create.ocrProgress: Reading the text of page {page} of {of}…
create.picturesLeftOut: Pictures left out — on the internet, in a format ⁧محرر PDF⁩ cannot draw, or damaged: {count}.
create.truncated: A file was too large to take whole; its far rows or last slides were left out.
compare.current: Revision {n} is the file as it stands now.
compare.failed: The two versions could not be compared.
compare.findFailed: The revisions of this file could not be read.
compare.intro: Shows what changed between two versions of a document, page by page: in the text, word by word, and in how each page looks.
compare.lookAlt: Page {page}, with what looks different outlined
compare.looksFailed: How the pages look could not be compared.
compare.looksHint: The words are the same, but some pages look different (pages: {count}): see Appearance.
compare.noText: Neither version has any text to compare. Scanned pages need a text layer first.
compare.note: The text is compared word by word; how each page looks is compared as it is drawn, which also shows pictures, drawings, stamps and layout.
compare.oneRevision: This file has only one revision: nothing has been saved onto it since it was made. Choose another PDF to compare it with.
compare.onlyNewer: This page is only in the newer version.
compare.onlyOlder: This page is only in the older version.
compare.optionsNote: These are the rules search follows in ⁧محرر PDF⁩.
compare.pageCountsDiffer: Pages in the older version: {older}; in the newer: {newer}. Pages are compared by position, so a page added or removed early on makes the pages after it look changed.
compare.reportLetters: أ إ آ ٱ were counted as alef, taa marbuta (ة) as haa, and alef maqsura (ى) as yaa.
compare.unifyLetters: Count أ إ آ ٱ as alef, taa marbuta (ة) as haa, and alef maqsura (ى) as yaa
compare.unreadable: The file could not be read as a PDF.
compress.balancedNote: Images larger than a page needs at 150 dpi become JPEG. Good for sharing and printing.
compress.failed: The file could not be compressed.
compress.losslessNote: Every image stays as it is; the file is rebuilt tighter.
compress.note: The open file is not changed. The smaller copy is a new file; it keeps no earlier revisions.
compress.refusedProtected: This file has a password. A smaller copy is written from scratch and would lose it; remove the password with Protect first if you want one.
compress.refusedSigned: This file is signed. A smaller copy is written from scratch and would break the signature.
compress.smallestNote: For reading on a screen; images lose detail when printed.
compress.unchanged: This file is already as small as it gets at this level. Nothing was changed.
drop.combine: Drop PDFs to add them to the list
drop.combineHint: The dropped PDFs join it in Combine, where you choose the order
drop.create: Drop files to add them to the list
drop.openHint: Shows the dropped file in place of this one
drop.overlay: Drop a PDF to open it — several PDFs go to Combine together
edit.addNoUndo: Added text cannot be undone yet. Close without saving to discard it.
edit.failed: The paragraph could not be replaced.
edit.fontSubstituted: The original font of that paragraph could not be reused, so the face chosen in the Edit panel was embedded instead. The replaced text may look different from the rest of the page.
edit.hintAdd: Add text draws one line where you click; Arabic grows leftwards from that point.
edit.hintClick: Click a paragraph, or reach it with Tab and press Enter.
edit.hintFont: A PDF carries only a subset of its own fonts, so an edit is shaped with the face chosen here and embedded beside them.
edit.hintKeys: {mod}+Enter, or a click outside, applies the change; Esc discards it.
edit.intro: Replace a paragraph in place. The core reflows and reshapes the text, then the page is drawn again from the result.
edit.placeHere: Click where the text should start
editPdf.dropPicture: Drop a picture to place it on the page
editPdf.failed: That change could not be made to the page.
editPdf.hintCrop: With Crop on, the handles cut that side of the picture away.
editPdf.hintDrawLink: Drag on the page to draw a new link's area.
editPdf.hintKeys: Arrow keys nudge it (Shift for ten points); Delete removes it.
editPdf.hintMove: Drag the picked picture to move it.
editPdf.hintMoveLink: Drag the picked link to move it, or a handle to resize it.
editPdf.hintResize: Drag a handle to resize it; hold Shift to keep its proportions.
editPdf.imageSharedNote: The same drawing puts this picture in several places, so it cannot be changed in one of them alone.
editPdf.inFormNote: This picture is drawn inside a group of the page's content; the change is made there.
editPdf.linkOther: This link goes somewhere ⁧محرر PDF⁩ does not follow (another file or a script). Give it an address or a page to change that.
editPdf.notPicture: Only PNG and JPEG pictures can be placed.
editPdf.pickLink: Click a link on the page to change it.
editPdf.pickPicture: Click a picture on the page to pick it.
editPdf.placing: Drag on the page where {name} goes, or click to place it at its own size. Shift fills the box exactly.
error.notPdf: Only PDF files can be opened.
error.password: This file is protected with a password.
export.excelNote: Each table on the pages — drawn with lines or lined up in columns — cell for cell, with merged cells kept and numbers as numbers (Arabic-Indic digits too); the rest of each page’s text in rows. A right-to-left page makes a right-to-left sheet. Charts and pictures are not kept.
export.failed: The document could not be exported.
export.htmlNote: Paragraphs, each with its own direction, and a heading for each page. No scripts, and nothing loaded from anywhere. Loses the layout and images.
export.imagesNote: Every page as a picture, exactly as it looks, at the resolution below. The text in a picture cannot be searched or selected. More than one page comes as one .zip.
export.intro: Save this document's content in another format. The text is each page as ⁧محرر PDF⁩ itself reads it, in reading order, taken from the file as it is now: text you have redacted is not in it.
export.markdownNote: Paragraphs as paragraphs, and a heading for each page. Loses the layout, fonts and images.
export.noText: No text was found in this document. If it is a scan, export page images instead; reading scans (OCR) comes later.
export.password: This copy is protected with a password set in Protect. Enter it to export.
export.pendingRedactions: Some marked areas have not been applied yet. A mark is not a redaction: until you apply it in Redact, the text under it is exported like the rest.
export.powerpointNote: A slide for each page, in the page’s shape: its pictures, shapes and colours behind, and its text on top in text boxes you can edit, where it was, right to left where it is Arabic. PowerPoint sets the text in its own fonts, so a line may run a little longer or shorter.
export.reduced: Some pages were too large for this resolution and were drawn at a lower one.
export.sheetsTable: One for each table (each page’s when there is none)
export.textNote: The text of every page in reading order, each page headed by a marker with its number. Loses the layout, fonts and images.
export.wordNote: Flowing paragraphs, right to left where the text is Arabic, with a page break between pages. Text only: the layout, images and tables are not kept.
file.saveFailed: The file could not be saved.
find.label: Find
forms.calc.applied: Saved in “{name}”. Other PDF readers that run form scripts calculate it too.
forms.calc.cycle: These calculations would depend on each other in a circle: {names}.
forms.calc.expressionNote: Use field names with + − × ÷ and parentheses. Put a name that has spaces in quotes.
forms.calc.noFields: This form has no text fields yet. Detect or add some first.
forms.calc.unsupported: This field has scripts ⁧محرر PDF⁩ does not run. Applying replaces its format, range and calculation.
forms.created: Fields created: {n}. Fill them in with Fill & sign, or give them formats and calculations below.
forms.detect.found: Fields found: {n}. Check them on the page before creating them.
forms.detect.none: No places to write were found. Add fields by hand below.
forms.detect.note: Finds where a flat form expects writing — lines of underscores or dots, empty boxes and table cells, lines to sign on, and check boxes — and names each field after its label.
forms.expr.syntax: ⁧محرر PDF⁩ cannot read this expression. Use field names, numbers, + − × ÷ and parentheses.
forms.failed: Prepare form could not finish. The file was not changed.
forms.format.hijriNote: Dates are typed as Hijri dates and checked against the Umm al-Qura calendar.
forms.proposal.name: Field name
forms.proposals.note: Drag a box to move it, drag its corner to resize it, and press Delete to remove it. Names come from the labels; change any you like.
forms.proposals.sameName: Two fields are named “{name}”. Fields with one name share one value, so give each its own.
forms.rejected.date: That is not a date in this field's pattern, so the previous value was kept.
forms.rejected.hijri: That is not a real Hijri date, so the previous value was kept.
forms.rejected.number: That value must be a number, so the previous one was kept.
forms.rejected.range: That value is outside the field's allowed range, so the previous one was kept.
forms.rejected.special: That value does not have the digits this field expects, so the previous one was kept.
forms.scripts.notRun: Scripts in this form that ⁧محرر PDF⁩ does not run: {n}
forms.scripts.why: ⁧محرر PDF⁩ runs only the standard formats, checks and calculations of form fields. Any other script is never executed; it is listed here so you know it is there.
forms.xfa.dropped: The XFA layer was removed. Every reader now shows the standard form.
forms.xfa.dynamic: This is a dynamic XFA form. Its pages are drawn by an XFA engine, which ⁧محرر PDF⁩ does not have: what you see is what the file shows without one, and it cannot be filled here.
forms.xfa.static: This is an XFA form. ⁧محرر PDF⁩ fills its standard form fields, but readers that use the XFA layer may still show the old values. Removing the XFA layer makes every reader show what you fill in.
goto.label: Page number (1–{total})
goto.title: Go to page
home.recentHint: Only the names and a small picture of each first page are kept, on this device; choose a file again to open it.
home.title: Home
lang.label: Language
link.confirmBody: The file links to this address. It will open in your browser:
link.confirmNote: Open it only if you trust this file: a link can lead somewhere other than its text suggests.
link.refusedBody: ⁧محرر PDF⁩ opens only web and e-mail addresses. This file links to something else:
marks.failed: The page marks could not be changed.
marks.intro: Watermarks, headers and footers, page numbers and Bates numbers, drawn into the file with Arabic shaped as it should be. They can be changed or taken off later without touching the page itself.
marks.none: This file has no marks from ⁧محرر PDF⁩ yet.
marks.pagesHint: Empty for every page, or pages such as 1-3, 5.
marks.pagesInvalid: These are not pages of this file.
marks.preview: Page {page} with the mark, as it will be drawn
marks.previewFailed: The preview could not be drawn.
marks.replaceNote: A new mark replaces one of the same kind on the same pages.
marks.skipFirst: No number on the first page
marks.slotsHint: In an Arabic header the start is on the right; in an English one, on the left.
menu.label: Main menu
ocr.alreadyDone: These pages already have a text layer from ⁧محرر PDF⁩.
ocr.done: Text layer added: {pages} pages, {words} words (confidence {confidence}%). Search and selection now work; save to keep it.
ocr.note: Recognition runs on this device; nothing is sent anywhere. The page looks exactly as before: the text is invisible, over the words. Diacritics are rarely read reliably.
ocr.nothing: No page needed recognizing: every page already has text.
organize.cropTooMuch: Those margins would leave nothing of a page.
organize.cropWhich: Applies to the selected pages, or to every page when none is selected.
organize.extracted: The pages were saved as a new file.
organize.failed: The pages could not be changed.
organize.hint: Click a page to select it. Shift-click selects a run of pages; Cmd- or Ctrl-click adds one. Drag pages to move them.
organize.insertFailed: That file could not be read as a PDF.
organize.insertPassword: “{name}” is protected. Enter its password to insert its pages.
organize.insertWhere: Its pages go in after the last selected page, or at the end.
organize.keepOne: A document keeps at least one page.
organize.saveNote: Changes go into the file when you save it. Extracting writes a new file and leaves this one as it is.
organize.splitDone: The parts are saved in one zip file.
organize.splitOne: That makes only one file: choose fewer pages per file, or select where each part begins.
organize.splitSelected: A new file at each selected page
pane.left.title: Navigation
pane.right.title: Tools
pane.toggleLeft: Show or hide the navigation pane
pane.toggleRight: Show or hide the tools pane
attachments.note: Attachments are never opened here. Save one, and check it before you open it.
attachments.removed: Removed. The file's earlier version still holds it until the file is written whole: Remove hidden information, in Redact, takes it out for good.
attachments.added: Attached. Save the file to keep it.
attachments.tooLarge: A file larger than 256 MB cannot be attached.
attachments.failed: The attachments could not be read or changed.
layers.keep: Save layer visibility with the file
layers.reset: Show as the file has them
layers.viewNote: Showing or hiding a layer changes only the view, until you save the visibility with the file.
layers.kept: The layers shown now will be saved with the file.
layers.readingOnly: Layers are shown and hidden in the reading view: close Edit text to change them.
layers.failed: The layers could not be changed.
password.body: “{name}” is protected. Enter its password to open it.
password.label: Password
password.title: Password required
password.wrong: That password did not open the file. Try again.
print.failed: The file could not be printed.
print.forbidden: This file does not allow printing.
ribbon.label: Tool ribbon
settings.title: Settings
shortcuts.browserNote: Some browsers reserve Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+N; use the page indicator in the status bar instead.
shortcuts.redo: Redo the change that was undone
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
status.editedHint: This document has changes that have not been saved to a file yet.
status.label: Status bar
status.mockCoreHint: The WASM core is not built yet; a mock document is shown.
switching.in: Handing the document over to the editor…
switching.out: Handing your changes back to the viewer…
theme.label: Theme
thumbs.label: Page thumbnails
tool.arabicDrawNote: Arabic typed into text boxes and form fields is drawn into the saved file by the Arabic engine of ⁧محرر PDF⁩, shaped and in an embedded face, where PDFium alone would leave it blank.
tool.comingLater: {tool} is coming in a later phase.
tool.notYet: {n} tools are not built yet and are marked Later.
tool.openFirst: Open a PDF to use this tool.
tool.redactNote: Applying redactions removes the text and images underneath from the file, not just the view. It cannot be undone after you save.
redact.search.title: Find and redact
redact.search.queryHint: Diacritics and the forms of alef, taa marbuta, yaa and digits do not matter, as in Find.
redact.search.marked: {count} marked for redaction. Check them on the page, then choose Apply redactions.
redact.search.badPattern: This pattern cannot be used: it is not valid, or it is too large.
redact.search.empty: Enter words, choose a pattern, or write your own.
redact.search.refused: Nothing was marked: this file's permissions do not allow its content to be changed.
redact.search.unplaced: Its place on the page is not known: mark it by hand.
redact.hidden.title: Remove hidden information
redact.hidden.intro: What the file carries besides its pages. Check it, choose, then remove: the file is written anew, without its earlier versions.
redact.hidden.kind.forms: Form fields and their data (their look is drawn into the page)
redact.hidden.kind.hiddenLayers: Hidden layers and what they draw
redact.hidden.kind.hiddenText: Hidden text: invisible, white on white or off the page (a scan's OCR text layer is invisible text)
redact.hidden.detail.Actions: Actions that run programs or send data: {count}
redact.hidden.property.Title: Title
redact.hidden.property.Author: Author
redact.hidden.property.Subject: Subject
redact.hidden.property.Creator: Created with
redact.hidden.always: Removed in any case, because the file is written whole: earlier versions ({revisions}) and objects nothing uses ({unreachable}).
redact.hidden.signed: The file is signed: once it is written anew, its signature will no longer be valid.
redact.hidden.protected: The file is protected by a password, which a file written anew would lose. Remove the password first, then remove the hidden information.
redact.hidden.pendingMarks: Apply or clear the redaction marks first.
redact.hidden.done: Removed. The file was written anew; save it to keep the change.
redact.hidden.failed: The hidden information could not be removed.
redact.hidden.checkFailed: The file could not be checked.
viewer.label: Document pages
signatures.status.untrusted: Intact — the signer's identity is not verified
signatures.change.lockedField: A field locked by a signature was changed
signatures.change.formChanged: Form fields added, removed or changed (not only filled in)
signatures.warn.rewrite: This file is signed. This tool rewrites the whole file when you save, and the signatures will be lost.
signatures.warn.certified: This file is certified, and its certification does not permit this kind of change: after saving, the certification will show as broken.
signatures.warn.approval: This file is signed. Changing its pages will show the signatures as changed after signing.
signatures.warn.fillOnly: This file is certified for filling in forms: filling in its fields keeps the certification, but placing a signature picture or a stamp breaks it.
signatures.warn.document: This file is signed. Adding or removing attachments changes the document itself, and its signatures will show as changed after signing.
signatures.warn.layers: This file is signed. Keeping these layers with the file changes the document, and its signatures will show as changed after signing.
signatures.banner.label: Digital signatures
signatures.problem.byteRange: The signed byte range is malformed or does not cover the signature's own revision.
signatures.problem.notInRevision: This signature dictionary is not the one in the revision it claims to sign: it was added or changed afterwards.
signatures.problem.noSigner: The signer's certificate is not in the signature.
signatures.problem.certBinding: The signature names a different certificate than the one it carries.
signatures.problem.notValidAtSigning: A certificate was not valid at the time of signing.
signatures.problem.revoked: The signer's certificate had been revoked before it signed.
signatures.problem.keyUsage: The certificate's key may not be used to sign.
signatures.problem.notYetValid: Not yet valid at that time: {name}
signatures.problem.notCa: Not a certification authority, yet it issued the certificate below it: {name}
signatures.problem.pathLen: Beyond the path length its issuer allows: {name}
signatures.problem.eku: The certificate is not issued for signing documents.
signatures.problem.ekuWeb: The certificate is issued for a web site, not for signing documents.
signatures.problem.ekuCa: Its authority may not certify signers of documents: {name}
signatures.problem.weakHash: Signed with SHA-1, which can be forged.
signatures.problem.weakHashCert: A certificate signed with SHA-1, which can be forged: {name}
signatures.problem.noProofOfTime: No trusted time proves when it was signed, so the certificates are judged as of now.
signatures.problem.tooManySignatures: Not checked: ⁧محرر PDF⁩ checks the first 30 signatures in a file.
signatures.problem.issuerSignature: The issuer's signature on {name} does not verify.
signatures.problem.cms: The signature could not be read: {detail}
signatures.problem.token: The timestamp could not be read: {detail}
signatures.why.unchecked: Not checked: this file has more signatures than ⁧محرر PDF⁩ checks (30).
signatures.why.notInRevision: This signature was added or changed after the revision it claims to sign, and may borrow another signature's data.
signatures.why.byteRange: What the signature covers is malformed.
signatures.why.digest: The signed content has changed since it was signed.
signatures.why.signature: The signature does not verify with the signer's key.
signatures.why.brokenPath: A certificate that may not issue certificates issued the signer's (or one above it): the chain is forged or broken.
signatures.why.keyUsage: The signer's certificate does not allow its key to sign.
signatures.why.revoked: The signer's certificate was revoked before it signed.
signatures.why.notValidAtSigning: A certificate was not valid when the signature was made.
signatures.why.invalid: Something the signature depends on is wrong; see the details.
signatures.why.webServer: The certificate was issued for a web site, not for signing documents: it proves control of a domain, not who signed.
signatures.why.purpose: The certificate was not issued for signing documents.
signatures.why.weakHash: It uses SHA-1, which can be forged, and no trusted time dates it before that was possible.
signatures.why.revokedLater: The signer's certificate has been revoked since.
signatures.why.webRoot: The signer's identity is not verified by a document-signing authority you trust: the certificate chains to {anchor}, which browsers trust for web sites, not for signers.
signatures.why.untrustedRoot: The signer's identity is not verified: the certificate chains to {root}, which you have not trusted.
signatures.why.incomplete: The signer's identity is not verified: the certificate of {missing}, which issued it, is missing.
signatures.why.noProofOfTime: A certificate has expired, and no trusted timestamp proves the signature was made before that.
signatures.why.untrusted: The signer's identity is not verified by an authority you trust.
signatures.detail.claimedName: The signature calls its signer {name} — the signer's own claim, not verified
signatures.detail.timestampUntrusted: Timestamp from {authority} ({date}), an authority you do not trust: its time is not relied on
signatures.detail.byteRange: Covers the whole revision it signed
signatures.detail.byteRangeBad: Does not cover exactly the revision it signed
signatures.detail.notInRevision: Not the signature dictionary of the revision it claims
signatures.detail.validAtSigning: Certificates valid when checked (at the trusted time, or now)
signatures.detail.validAtSigningBad: A certificate is not valid when checked (at the trusted time, or now)
signatures.detail.timestampUntrustedChec: Timestamp verifies, but {authority} is not an authority you trust
signatures.detail.wholeFile: Nothing was added to the file after this signature.
signatures.detail.laterRevisions: The file was updated after this signature; the changes are listed above.
signatures.kind.certification2: Certification: filling forms and signing allowed
signatures.kind.certification3: Certification: forms, signing and comments allowed
signatures.trust.byYou: Trusted: {anchor} (trusted by you on this device)
signatures.trust.webRoot: Ends at {anchor}, which browsers trust for web sites — not for who signs documents
signatures.trust.untrustedRoot: Ends at a root nobody here trusts: {root}
signatures.trust.incomplete: Incomplete: the certificate of {missing} is missing
signatures.trust.broken: Broken at {name}: it may not issue certificates
signatures.trust.title: Certificates you trust
signatures.trust.none: None yet, so no signer's identity is verified. Mozilla's root store, which browsers use for web sites, is used here only for timestamp authorities.
signatures.trust.add: Trust a certificate from a file (.cer, .pem, .p7b)
signatures.trust.notCertificate: No certificate was found in that file.
signatures.trust.note: Trust is kept on this device only. Trust a certificate only if you know it vouches for who signs documents — for example your organization's or your country's certification authority.
signatures.revocation.good: Revocation data in the file: not revoked
signatures.revocation.revoked: Revocation data in the file: revoked
signatures.revocation.unknown: Revocation data in the file: status unknown
signatures.revocation.notChecked: No revocation data in the file for this certificate
signatures.ltv.title: Long-term validation
signatures.ltv.webNote: Timestamps and revocation data come from servers that do not let a web page read their answers, so the browser version cannot fetch them. The desktop app can.
signatures.ltv.note: Fetches the certificates' revocation status from their issuers and keeps it in the file, so the signatures can still be checked after the certificates expire. The issuers learn which certificates are being checked.
signatures.ltv.added: Added {certs} certificates, {ocsps} status answers and {crls} revocation lists.
signatures.ltv.reason.badAnswer: its answer could not be used
signatures.ltv.rejected: {count} answers did not check out and were not added.
signatures.saveToKeep: Signed. Save the file to keep it.
signatures.error.unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check the connection, or choose another server.
signatures.error.badAnswer: The server answered, but its answer could not be used.
signatures.error.check: The signatures in this file could not be checked.
signatures.error.password: The certificate file's password is wrong.
signatures.error.p12: This is not a certificate file ⁧محرر PDF⁩ can read (.p12 or .pfx with a private key).
signatures.error.certifyFirst: Only the first signature can certify a file; this one already has a signature.
signatures.error.certified: This file is certified with no changes allowed, so it cannot be signed again.
signatures.error.pin: The PIN is wrong, or the card is locked.
signatures.error.token: The smart card or token could not be used. Check the module path and that the card is inserted.
signatures.error.tokenLogin: This card's key asks for the PIN again for every signature, which ⁧محرر PDF⁩ cannot do yet. Sign with a certificate file instead.
signatures.error.timestamp: The timestamp could not be obtained, and nothing was signed. Try another timestamp server, or sign without one.
signatures.error.failed: The file could not be signed.
signatures.error.image: That picture could not be read.
signatures.error.tooLarge: This signed file could not be saved without breaking its signatures (it is too large to keep as an update in memory), so it was not saved. Undo the changes made in the view, or close other files and try again.
signatures.none: This file has no digital signatures.
signatures.dss: Validation data in the file: {certs} certificates, {ocsps} status answers, {crls} revocation lists.
signatures.tsa.label: Timestamp server
signatures.tsa.privacy: Only when you sign does the chosen server receive anything: a digest — a fingerprint of the signature or of the file — never the document itself. It answers with the time it saw it.
signatures.sign.notValidNow: This certificate is not valid now.
signatures.sign.visible: Show the signature on the page
signatures.sign.drawHint: Drag on the page to draw where the signature goes.
signatures.sign.image: A picture of your handwritten signature (optional)
signatures.sign.certifyFirstNote: Only the first signature in a file can certify it.
signatures.sign.lock: Lock the form fields once signed
signatures.sign.timestampWeb: Trusted timestamps are added by the desktop app: timestamp servers do not let a web page read their answers.
signatures.sign.done: Signed. The signature is in the open file; save it to keep it.
signatures.sign.note: The file is signed as it stands, with every change made so far. Anything changed afterwards is added after the signature and listed when it is checked.
signatures.token.note: The key never leaves the card: only the digest to be signed is sent to it.
signatures.token.untested: Signing with a card has not yet been tried with a real card. If it fails, sign with a certificate file.
